notes.title: New Update Now Live - Stuttering Effect Solved
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We have noticed a handful of reports from players saying they are experiencing what appears to be a stuttering effect in game. This looks visually like a low frame rate, however the game itself it running at a much higher frame rate.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/0b1286207e2a6b7cbc5b982b90a940ddf3201b18.jpg[/img]

This issue is caused by a change in how often the physics system updates in the game - this was changed to help optimise the game further on lower end machines, but created a stuttering effect on higher end machines because of the difference between the physics update and the frame rate on screen. 

To address this, the physics will now update much quicker in game and should remove stuttering effect.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5b2541b23a37a7eb46a976aaab2ce490673fd29c.png[/img]

We have also given the player the ability to further adjust how often this happens with launch options.

However this will make the mouse sensitivity much greater so this may need to be adjusted by the player in game.

[h1]Setting Launch Options[/h1]

- Open your library and locate Jalopy
- Right Click on Jalopy and select "Properties"
- In the general tab, click on "Set Launch Options"
- type in -fixedTime 0.01
- This will trigger the physics at 100 times a second (100fps)

We have also adjusted the default launch options for the game.

The game no longer support opengl and DX11 also will be dropped from the default launch options as this was no longer being utilised.

In place of this you will find alternative launch options which are the following:

Play on low spec PC
Play on high spec PC

These options adjust the physics updates to optimise the game for different types of PCs. 

If you have any issues or require further support.
Please email our team at support@excalibur-games.com

Thanks,
The Jalopy Team

notes.title: Jalopy Update Now Live on the Public Beta Branch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I'm excited to announce that Jalopy's March update is now live on the public beta branch! We're glad to be able to get the update out to you all today, and we are listening for feedback on further improvements.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/49e0365ff01083c80ea105a20cda6b824f17944d.jpg[/img]

Today's update sees Jalopy upgraded to a new version of Unity and introduces countless bug fixes. To access the new update, please follow these instructions:

[b]- Load up Steam and head to your library
- Right click on Jalopy and then select "Properties"
- Head to the Beta tab and in the drop down select "public_beta" (no password needed)
- This will then download the new update for you[/b]

With Jalopy being rewritten for a new version of Unity, there will no doubt be a few teething issues (which is why we want to offer the update in beta before it goes to final).

As the save system has been rewritten, we recommend backing up your save before trying out the update beta, just incase.

To back up your saves...

-	Press the windows key + R on your keyboard to open the run console
-	Type in “%appdata%\..\locallow\MinskWorks\Jalopy” and click “ok”
-	Highlight all current files, right click and select “send to” and then “compressed (zip) folder”
-	Name this folder Save Backup

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/93e24416568a2497e804e7815baa3957b89f9b82.png[/img]

Please do make sure to offer your feedback on the Steam forums and to let us know if you run into any issues by emailing support@excalibur-games.com.

Thanks,
The Jalopy Team

notes.title: Community Translators Added To In Game Credits
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

An update to the game has just been made live which has made some additions to the credits screen in game. As you may know, Jalopy was translated into many languages with the help of the community and we wanted to thank those who assisted us over the past several months.

The names of the community translators (who have gotten back to us based on an email survey we had sent out) has been added to the credits list. We are very lucky to have such a great community who have helped Jalopy release with support for the following languages.

[list][*]English
[*]French
[*]German
[*]Italian
[*]Spanish
[*]Japanese
[*]Korean
[*]Russian
[*]Brazilian Portuguese
[*]Turkish
[*]Hungarian
[*]Chinese (Simplified)
[*]Dutch
[*]Norwegian
[*]Finnish
[*]Slovakian
[*]Romanian
[*]Croatian
[*]Polish[/list]

If you were one of the translators, you should be able to find your name in the translators credit screen which appears after the normal credits. Once again, we thank you all for your hard work in helping us to translate Jalopy into 18 languages. We have seen many players in territories outside of the US and UK enjoy the game and it could not have been done without you. Thank you!

Today is Jalopy 1.0 Day! This marks the end of the development period for Jalopy as it becomes a final game. You have helped support us, offered valuable constructive feedback and it has been a pleasure to be a part of this community. Thank you to everyone involved in helping us get to this milestone.

You can read the full announcement to 1.0 below where we answer some of the Early Access Questions and detail areas where we were unable to deliver on particular areas of the game. 

http://steamcommunity.com/games/446020/announcements/detail/1646502942058943218

To celebrate the release of Jalopy, we are offering a 40% discount for launch week. Check out the Steam page below to purchase the game at this special launch discount:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/446020/Jalopy/

We also have a brand-new trailer which details many of the core gameplay mechanics, explained by Uncle Lüfti. This is a great way for people who have never played the game to see some of the mechanics that are available in the game. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nzI-VDliyko

Trading Cards have also just gone live along with a series of Emoticons including perhaps the greatest of all emoticons available on Steam right now… ːUncleFaceː

notes.title: Jalopy Leaves Early Access On 28th March 2018
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we are sharing some important news on Jalopy: version 1.0 will drop on 28th March 2018, marking the end of the Early Access period.

Jalopy has been in development for over three years now, and debuted in Early Access nearly two years ago. Greg has been the sole developer of the project, but along the way we’ve had others help us, including Jeremy, who scored the fantastic soundtrack.

We would like to thank everyone who has purchased the game so far and has helped to support the game’s development for the past two years. We hope that you have enjoyed watching the game grow and have loved being a part of this road-trip. 

Jalopy’s full launch on 28th March will also see the debut of full translation into 18 different languages. Thanks to the wonderful community translation project, 28th March will see Jalopy available fully translated into the following languages:

At the beginning of Jalopy’s life, and throughout the Early Access period, a number of questions and answers have been present on Jalopy’s Steam store page – and now that we have almost reached the end of Early Access it feels right to revisit those questions. 

 [h1]Why Early Access?[/h1]
“The instant feedback from Steam players allows us to reshuffle our priorities during development to make an even better game. During the Early Access period the game will most certainly contain a selection of bugs, glitches, and issues that can impact a traditional game experience. If you do buy the game and come across something odd, please tell us in the forums.”

Jalopy has contained many bugs and issues throughout the development period - we’re still ironing out just a few, but believe that the game breaking issues are gone (do let us know if you come across any game breaking issues, though!).

Most notably we saw the uncle removed from the game for a period and then eventually brought him back after we fixed some of the issues that were present because of his role in the game. He has since returned, new and improved, with a stronger emphasis on the narrative of Jalopy and has given the game an ending for players.

[h1]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h1]
“We are looking to release the full game towards the end of 2017.”
We are a little late on this estimation. It took a little longer for us to handle the localisation than we expected. Jalopy will launch as a full game on 28th March 2018.

[h1]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h1]
“In Early Access you will be able to drive, explore and trade throughout Germany & the CSFR. Already, the player can make changes to their vehicle with millions of combinations available to affect vehicle performance. As we progress through Early Access we plan to let the player drive through 1990’s renditions of Hungary, Yugoslavia, Bulgaria and Turkey. Early Access will be an insight into the core mechanics of Jalopy and from here we plan to build around this core with feedback from the community.”

At launch we began with just the countries of Germany and CSFR. We have since added all promised countries including Hungary, Yugoslavia, Bulgaria and Turkey. During development we worked on improving the vehicle handling and have added new unlocks to the vehicle like an internal dashboard display, paint and a few other upgrades to the car itself. We also introduced the scrapyard, which allows players to scavenge for goods if they can figure out how to unlock the gate. Jeremy also created new pieces of music for each country as they released.

[h1]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h1]
“The game contains all final countries planned for the final game. Players can upgrade their car, purchase new components, scavenge for items and drive back to the starting area once they reach the final destination.”

This section was adjusted throughout development in order to reflect the current status of the game. 

[h1]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h1]
“The price may increase with significant content updates. We will let everyone know if the price is expected to rise before it increases.”

The game did increase in price slightly during development and we communicated the increase with players. With the announcement of the last price increase, we alerted players that this was the final time the price would increase.

[h1]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/h1]
“Once we get into Early Access we’re going to be looking at the most important features within the first week or two of release. From here we will create a development roadmap so that everyone can visualise where the game is heading and can get involved. Of course, do say hi to us in the Steam forums and let us know your thoughts on the game.”

This may have changed a little since the beginning of Early Access. We responded to several bugs and issues, the largest of which was the uncle causing crashes. Our development roadmap was predominately based around the addition of countries. Greg had a Tumblr blog where he would answer questions directly and share progress and concerns during development. We often had pages of change logs for each update and worked on making these updates exciting events. We additionally set the Beta Branch accessible to all players during some testing phases so players would see advance builds before they were made public. This assisted in locating important issues as we prepared for builds to go public.

[h1]What We Could Not Deliver[/h1]
Now this is an interesting but particularly difficult subject to discuss. However, I feel it’s important to speak about the elements which we were unable to achieve, despite us discussing them in the past or having hopes that these would eventually see the light of day.

[b]Steering Wheel Support[/b]
We managed to get the game running well on one type of steering wheel. We did release a build on Steam with the following disclaimer on 20th September 2017:

“The latest build adds steering wheel support, but there is a massive disclaimer we need to mention. We have been performing some tests internally and there are still issues with this. There are still many wheels that are not yet functioning correctly and is something that is being looked at. If you experience non-functioning pedals, or the view rotates without any input, we highly recommend that you continue to use a mouse and keyboard or a game pad instead.“

There were a few questions in the forum asking about steering wheel support over time, and I replied personally to some and said that if they wanted to buy the game because of steering wheel support, I highly recommend that they wait until a later date.

Unfortunately, we have been unable to make any progress on this area and there will be no steering wheel support for Jalopy. It is disappointing, and something we hoped would be in the game, but we were unable to truly support it and get it working for everyone.

[b]Mac Support[/b]
We were intending to support Mac early on in development – however, as we were looking towards a 1.0 release, we came across some issues that would make the transition from Windows to Mac much more difficult. In February, I posted the following in response to a thread asking for Mac support.

“Unfortunately porting to Mac would require the game to be rewritten in xcode and new shaders would need to be created. We are also suffering from ram issues due to the version of Unity we're running (Unity 4.6). So it seems like it will be very unlikely for a Mac version to happen.”

A little time has passed since that post, and unfortunately Mac support is not going to be possible for Jalopy, due to issues with the game engine.

So, there we go! Right now, we’re working on implementing translations and fixing any game-breaking bugs for the final release. If you do spot any bugs and can reproduce it 100%, send us over the details of what happens and how to reproduce it - we will look towards addressing any such issues. 

We will likely have a launch discount for Jalopy on the 28th of March, so stay tuned for further information over the next couple of weeks.

Thank you once again for joining us on this Jalopy journey. It’s been a road trip like no other.

notes.title: Build 0962 Is Now Live
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We're still handling the localisation of Jalopy, of which 14 have been completed. Though there are also an additional half a dozen which are still being completed. 

Today's update fixes a long standing bug where after a certain period of time you are no longer able to pick up objects. I'd like to thank everyone who gave us feedback and information on when it had happened. We were contacted by email with a 100% repro rate and in that case we have fixed and addressed. Thanks to everyone who has been waiting patiently for this fix.

The change log is below:

[h1]Build 0.962[/h1] 
[list][*]Fixed wallet value 1 not showing correctly 
[*]Fixed Pushing and stopping car with keys not triggering uncle 
[*]Removed Notice Board on main menu 
[*]Fixed Performance issue caused by Uncle looking at you from afar 
[*]Fixed being unable to interact midway through games
[*]Fixed crash caused from sleeping a second time[/list]

Of course, do let us know if you find any issues/ bugs!

notes.title: The Uncle Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/1d9c263a4c0b04079320a67341d70327fe1f79ee.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone,

Jalopy receives a pretty major update today which brings back the Uncle and introduces a narrative element to the game.  I’ll go through some of the larger points included in this update, but there will of course be a large change log at the end of this post for you to read in more detail.

[h1]The Uncle Is Back[/h1]
Your second travelling companion (of course, after the Laika 601 Deluxe) asks you to transport him to Turkey. Along the way, he’ll share information of the local area, warn you when your bonnet is open and may help you if you have begun running a bit low on funds. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/0b1286207e2a6b7cbc5b982b90a940ddf3201b18.jpg[/img]

There’s always been a divide of opinion on the uncle, some love him and his dimension shifting jacket, while others have a hatred that matches that of standing bare foot on a Lego piece. So with that in mind, once you complete the tutorial and complete your first route. When you load up the game you will be given the option to either have him accompany you on your journey or leave him behind. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/81f7089bd8b780ec2f165b7afd29e9e3e4c2378a.jpg[/img]

Uncle may still be a little buggy. But do let us know if he begins to misbehave!
Of course, the narrative elements introduced via the uncle is something that you should discover yourself. We hope you enjoy the story!

[h1]Steering Wheel Support[/h1]
The latest build adds steering wheel support, but there is a massive disclaimer we need to mention. We have been performing some tests internally and there are still issues with this. There are still many wheels that are not yet functioning correctly and is something that is being looked at.  If you experience non-functioning pedals, or the view rotates without any input, we highly recommend that you continue to use a mouse and keyboard or a game pad instead. 

[h1]Statistics[/h1]
If you’ve ever wanted to know how many footsteps you’ve taken, how many tyres you’ve popped and what your top speed is, you’re in luck! The statistics screen now tracks many of your actions while playing. I’ll be personally curious to see who will be able to reach the highest speed in their Laika 601 Deluxe.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/8a106bb2b857120d2f546c1d87c1dddcc69c98d5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
Achievements have been added! There are some particularly easy achievements that ca n be obtained within minutes, but then there’s some tough ones for those staying for the long haul. Good luck everyone!

[h1]Trabant Car Challenge with Hat Films[/h1]
And finally, we have been working with Hat Films to create a three part series where the guys from Hat films drive a couple of Trabants. The first episode is live now, you can watch it below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEOgev7e_Vw

So, there we go! This update helps to fill a narrative shaped hole which was in Jalopy. Of course, there are a few dozen fixes for some issues as well. If you experience any issues, do let us know in the forums! Thankyou everyone for the support and patience as we’ve been working on this update.

If you'd like to read the full change logs click the link below:

[url=https://www.excalibur-publishing.com/blogs/news/jalopy-uncle-update] Change Log[/url]

notes.title: The Uncle Update Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/1d9c263a4c0b04079320a67341d70327fe1f79ee.jpg[/img]

Hello Everyone,

Jalopy receives a pretty major update today which brings back the Uncle and introduces a narrative element to the game.  I’ll go through some of the larger points included in this update, but there will of course be a large change log at the end of this post for you to read in more detail.

[h1]The Uncle Is Back[/h1]
Your second travelling companion (of course, after the Laika 601 Deluxe) asks you to transport him to Turkey. Along the way, he’ll share information of the local area, warn you when your bonnet is open and may help you if you have begun running a bit low on funds. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/0b1286207e2a6b7cbc5b982b90a940ddf3201b18.jpg[/img]

There’s always been a divide of opinion on the uncle, some love him and his dimension shifting jacket, while others have a hatred that matches that of standing bare foot on a Lego piece. So with that in mind, once you complete the tutorial and complete your first route. When you load up the game you will be given the option to either have him accompany you on your journey or leave him behind. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/81f7089bd8b780ec2f165b7afd29e9e3e4c2378a.jpg[/img]

Uncle may still be a little buggy. But do let us know if he begins to misbehave!
Of course, the narrative elements introduced via the uncle is something that you should discover yourself. We hope you enjoy the story!

[h1]Steering Wheel Support[/h1]
The latest build adds steering wheel support, but there is a massive disclaimer we need to mention. We have been performing some tests internally and there are still issues with this. There are still many wheels that are not yet functioning correctly and is something that is being looked at.  If you experience non-functioning pedals, or the view rotates without any input, we highly recommend that you continue to use a mouse and keyboard or a game pad instead. 

[h1]Statistics[/h1]
If you’ve ever wanted to know how many footsteps you’ve taken, how many tyres you’ve popped and what your top speed is, you’re in luck! The statistics screen now tracks many of your actions while playing. I’ll be personally curious to see who will be able to reach the highest speed in their Laika 601 Deluxe.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/8a106bb2b857120d2f546c1d87c1dddcc69c98d5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Achievements[/h1]
Achievements have been added! There are some particularly easy achievements that ca n be obtained within minutes, but then there’s some tough ones for those staying for the long haul. Good luck everyone!

[h1]Trabant Car Challenge with Hat Films[/h1]
And finally, we have been working with Hat Films to create a three part series where the guys from Hat films drive a couple of Trabants. The first episode is live now, you can watch it below:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEOgev7e_Vw

So, there we go! This update helps to fill a narrative shaped hole which was in Jalopy. Of course, there are a few dozen fixes for some issues as well. If you experience any issues, do let us know in the forums! Thankyou everyone for the support and patience as we’ve been working on this update.

If you'd like to read the full change logs click the link below:

[url=https://www.excalibur-publishing.com/blogs/news/jalopy-uncle-update] Change Log[/url]

notes.title: Jalopy - Price Increase Announcement
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We must welcome everyone who has joined us over the last several days during the Steam summer sale. I'd also like to give a thank you to those who have been helping out our new players by answering questions in the forum.

I wanted to let everyone know that we are planning to increase the price for Jalopy slightly shortly after the Steam Summer sale. This will be the final price of the game and there will be no more price increases after this... This also means there will be no price increase for the games full game launch. 

Of course, if you bought the game already, you of course don't need to pay any extra! I didn't think I would need to mention this but I believe I will still get this question via email a few times :)

There are several reasons to initiate a price increase, but one of the biggest reasons is to maximize the games presence when it does launch as a full game. It's all very boring behind the scenes strategy to help market the game  and is part of the less interesting side of game development, but I hope that many of you understand as it will allow us to reach more players and hope to sustain a good future for us even after the games full release.

As promised in the Early Access questions, I said that I would let everyone know if a price increase was planned to happen. It's not an easy job to value and price your game (in fact this is the most difficult thing to do in order to value the worth of something you have worked on!).

Thank you to everyone who has bought the game so far and helped support us. We hope that you've enjoyed the game so far and continue to support us by leaving questions and engaging in the forums.

Now, regarding the actual development!

Right now Greg is working on bringing back the Uncle, but also looking at Steering Wheel Support as well. Sorry this post isn't very development heavy, it's more of an admin related post. We''ll get to the more exciting side of Games development very soon and show off new things within the next few weeks!

[h1]Update 7th July 2017:[/h1]
The price Increase is now live.

notes.title: 22nd of June Update - Border Guard Issue Fixed! Sorry To Keep You Weighting
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some major fixes today which fix a progress stopping bug which was introduced in the last update. We'd like to thank everyone who has taken the time to let us know about this and helped us locate it. You guys are awesome!

Other additions and changes have been based on the weight of the car, this includes fixes to the digital dash, weight effecting tyre grip as well as the acceleration of your vehicle. 

I hope the awful headline now makes a bit more sense... Sorry about that

The full change log is below!

[h1]Build 0.83[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed index issue with the User Manual 
[*]Digital Dash now updates weight icon correctly 
[*]Digital Dash weight alert values increased 
[*]Fixed issue where more weight on the car actually made it accelerate faster... 
[*]Increased effective of total car weight on tyre grip by 10x (more tyre grip when carrying heavier cargo) 
[*]Car Weight reduction to acceleration increased by 10x (cargo weight now greatly reduces acceleration) 
[*]Car weight now affects acceleration performance incrementally, based on the base power of the installed engine (i.e. if you have an old, broken engine, weight will be even more of an issue than if you had a sweet engine fully repaired) 
[*]Fuel mix now affects engine audio 
[*]Engine condition now affects engine audio 
[*]Cursor off in the pause menu now works 
[*]Fixed issue with ignition coils going below 0 condition. 
[*]Fixed text delay on Motel owner 
[*]Fixed baskets leaving two items in the basket when trying to bulk sell 
[*]fuel can should now close it's lid after refueling it 
[*]moved 2-stroke, fuel cans, car jacks, crowbars, water & buckets over to the new pricing system 
[*]Fixed border typo : "you will be charged" to "You will be charged" (thanks "that guy") [/list]

[h1]Build 0.831[/h1]
[list][*]Removed old price tag for tyre repair kit 
[*]Fixed soft lock with border guards searching cars without a roof rack
[*]Fixed some more delays in dialogue text 
[*]Fixed car shaking when failing to start ignition[/list]

As always, let us know if you spot any bugs! Thanks everyone and we hope you enjoy this update.

notes.title: Jalopy Update: FPS improvements, Ignition Coils and Harassing Guests
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

A new update has just gone live which predominately fixes some of the low FPS some machines are having. Be warned, that if you have all effects on, high traffic, enabled mirrors, this can impact your performance. So if you are still experiencing low FPS, please do try changing the settings in the options menu.

There are a few changes to the ignition coil, border patrol and how you interact with the world with regards to bad driving and disturbing motel guests! 

Full change log below!

[h1]Build 0826[/h1]
- Ignition Coil ignition time increased by 5x 
- Fixed issue with ignition coil damage not changing their performance 
- Ignition Coil ignition time increased by 10x, 5x, 2.5x based on condition 
- Improved top speed of squash engines 
- Border Guards now search roof inventory 
- Players now fined for taking stolen goods through border checkpoints 
- Players now fined at border checkpoints for dangerous driving 
- Fines no longer display on the car window 
- Harrassing motel guests now increases the chance of border guards searching players vehicles 
- Border Guards now search baskets
- Uncle Walk speed up 
- Added Uncle footstep audio 
- Fixed Uncle facial animation issues on lower graphical settings 
- Added Car Registration details to the user manual (Reg number, reg location, reg date - all unique to each player). 
- Fixed issue with home garage fuel tank fuel changing 
- Fixed mesh misalignment of the replacement door 
- Added lock shake when picking up wooden boxes 
- Increased dialogue box size 
- Fixed text issue in the User Manual 
- Optimisation : moved car shadows to GPU 
- Optimisation : Stored camera references in the new handling system

[h1]Build - 0.827[/h1] 
- Fixed falling through environment issue in Bulgaria (0-0_05) 
- Fixed Uncle animation issue 
- Fixed Uncle spinning during tutorial 
- Cleaned up dialogue transitions 
- Increased player mass to lower sliding
- Uncle now correctly leaves car at start of tutorial again

If you come across any issues, do let us know in the forums!

notes.title: Turkey Update Is Live! Soundtrack, Tyre Repair Kits, Licence Plates, Key Rebinding
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/43dc2233bfcf0dcd73e6a459c6afa71c17bbdb87.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, today marks the release of the Turkey update which acts as our final destination for map content in Jalopy. It’s been quite a journey and we are now towards the final stretch for full release. Greg is already working on the next content update and is looking at The Uncle, achievements, wheel input etc. 

The Turkey update has been in the Testing branch for a little while and I’d like to take this time to thank everyone who was involved! You guys are awesome and have really helped us by reporting bugs in the forum or directly via Greg’s tumblr blog (http://minskworks.tumblr.com/)

So what’s in the update? There’s a massive change log at the bottom of this announcement which details all the changes that happened between the last public release and the Turkey update. We believe this is probably our largest update of bug fixes to date and hope we’ve eliminated quite a few issues. We’ll highlight some of the major changes below:

[h1]Turkey map[/h1]
The biggest addition to this update is the addition of Turkey.  To celebrate the launch of this we created a new trailer which shows a portion of the Turkey route
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fv15ALcU320

[h1]The Official Jalopy Sound Track[/h1]
Jeremy Warmsley has been outputting some tremendous music for Jalopy and we feel that he has captured the games tone perfectly. Two new tracks are a part of this update and can be listened to in game right now!

There are currently no plans to produce any additional music, so we felt it was the right time to release the full sound track on Steam. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/646780/Jalopy__Soundtrack

The soundtrack in game has an audio effect which makes it sound as though it's coming from the old speakers of a Laika 601 Deluxe. The soundtrack however has crisp high quality effects which do not have any audio effects applied to them. We are considering updating the soundtrack in the future to include additional tracks which replicate the laika 601 Deluxe's audio effects. let us know if this is something you want included as an update to the soundtrack!

Track listing below:

01 Meinen Laika
02 Lange Reise
03 Dresdner Automobilclub
04 Harmonikatalas
05 Krugovi
06 Dunaújváros Daytripping
07 Let's Go For A Drive
07 Plazhen Tants
09 Kalkan
10 Balkan Girl I Love You!
11 Yuva Hatıraları
12 Anthem Zu Lieben

 [h1]Tyre Repair Kits[/h1]
Tyres can now be repaired with the new Tyre repair kit. They are cheaper than purchasing a replacement tyre and easy to use. Just unscrew the tyre from the axel and use the tyre repair kit directly onto the tyre while it is still attatched to the 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/ab812a2e2d87c12734b6c537133d1609a6cf0495.png[/img]

The price of tyres based on their compound has also been balanced.

[h1]Licence Plates[/h1]
The game will now generate a random Licence plate for your Laika 601 Deluxe. These License Plates adhere to the real world licencing rules in the DDR. What this means is that if you can decipher your licence plate you will be able to find out a little bit of history of your trusty Laika. Share your discoveries in the forum!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5b2541b23a37a7eb46a976aaab2ce490673fd29c.png[/img]

Additionally, Abandoned cars will also spawn with a random licence plate, this feature may be expanded upon in the future but we'll keep you posted.

[h1]Drive Back Home[/h1]

With this update players are now able to drive back towards home, allowing them to drive all the way back to the Uncle who will be patiently waiting for them at the abandoned Laika Garage which you call home.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5d6f881d44fd2ae29b4de8f37a38e9553f1c75da.png[/img]

[h1]Car handling improved[/h1]
A number of changes have been made to the car handling which should improve the quality of both keyboard and mouse as well as controller users

[h1] Key Bindings[/h1]
We have also added new options for rebinding keys which you can adjust within the options menu[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/a943f21bf86bc8344249656b52bd9a7c5ab45ad1.png[/img]

There are a few more things that have been added and refined, but you can check out the full change Log list below:


[h1]Build 0.811[/h1]

- Fixed issue with shops banning the wrong goods in the mornings 
- Fixed Bullbar dirt mesh issue

notes.title: Turkey Update Is Live! Soundtrack, Tyre Repair Kits, Licence Plates, Key Rebinding
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/43dc2233bfcf0dcd73e6a459c6afa71c17bbdb87.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone, today marks the release of the Turkey update which acts as our final destination for map content in Jalopy. It’s been quite a journey and we are now towards the final stretch for full release. Greg is already working on the next content update and is looking at The Uncle, achievements, wheel input etc. 

The Turkey update has been in the Testing branch for a little while and I’d like to take this time to thank everyone who was involved! You guys are awesome and have really helped us by reporting bugs in the forum or directly via Greg’s tumblr blog (http://minskworks.tumblr.com/)

So what’s in the update? There’s a massive change log at the bottom of this announcement which details all the changes that happened between the last public release and the Turkey update. We believe this is probably our largest update of bug fixes to date and hope we’ve eliminated quite a few issues. We’ll highlight some of the major changes below:

[h1]Turkey map[/h1]
The biggest addition to this update is the addition of Turkey.  To celebrate the launch of this we created a new trailer which shows a portion of the Turkey route
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fv15ALcU320

[h1]The Official Jalopy Sound Track[/h1]
Jeremy Warmsley has been outputting some tremendous music for Jalopy and we feel that he has captured the games tone perfectly. Two new tracks are a part of this update and can be listened to in game right now!

There are currently no plans to produce any additional music, so we felt it was the right time to release the full sound track on Steam. 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/646780/Jalopy__Soundtrack

The soundtrack in game has an audio effect which makes it sound as though it's coming from the old speakers of a Laika 601 Deluxe. The soundtrack however has crisp high quality effects which do not have any audio effects applied to them. We are considering updating the soundtrack in the future to include additional tracks which replicate the laika 601 Deluxe's audio effects. let us know if this is something you want included as an update to the soundtrack!

Track listing below:

01 Meinen Laika
02 Lange Reise
03 Dresdner Automobilclub
04 Harmonikatalas
05 Krugovi
06 Dunaújváros Daytripping
07 Let's Go For A Drive
07 Plazhen Tants
09 Kalkan
10 Balkan Girl I Love You!
11 Yuva Hatıraları
12 Anthem Zu Lieben

 [h1]Tyre Repair Kits[/h1]
Tyres can now be repaired with the new Tyre repair kit. They are cheaper than purchasing a replacement tyre and easy to use. Just unscrew the tyre from the axel and use the tyre repair kit directly onto the tyre while it is still attatched to the 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/ab812a2e2d87c12734b6c537133d1609a6cf0495.png[/img]

The price of tyres based on their compound has also been balanced.

[h1]Licence Plates[/h1]
The game will now generate a random Licence plate for your Laika 601 Deluxe. These License Plates adhere to the real world licencing rules in the DDR. What this means is that if you can decipher your licence plate you will be able to find out a little bit of history of your trusty Laika. Share your discoveries in the forum!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5b2541b23a37a7eb46a976aaab2ce490673fd29c.png[/img]

Additionally, Abandoned cars will also spawn with a random licence plate, this feature may be expanded upon in the future but we'll keep you posted.

[h1]Drive Back Home[/h1]

With this update players are now able to drive back towards home, allowing them to drive all the way back to the Uncle who will be patiently waiting for them at the abandoned Laika Garage which you call home.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/5d6f881d44fd2ae29b4de8f37a38e9553f1c75da.png[/img]

[h1]Car handling improved[/h1]
A number of changes have been made to the car handling which should improve the quality of both keyboard and mouse as well as controller users

[h1] Key Bindings[/h1]
We have also added new options for rebinding keys which you can adjust within the options menu[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/a943f21bf86bc8344249656b52bd9a7c5ab45ad1.png[/img]

notes.title: The Turkey Testing Branch Is Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/6025d8c93a3894cb57824032004f1888a4eb0ff1.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! Today we have some great news for you, we’re going to be releasing a testing branch for the Turkey update. We intend to release the Turkey update in May but of course, no matter how much testing we put into the build, it cannot replicate the thousands of hours that the community can produce! So, we’re bound to miss a few things!

If you want to help us find those last few bugs then we’d greatly appreciate it. I’m going to tidy up the Steam Forums and introduce a new sub forum called the Turkey Bug Forum where players can report and post any issues that they have found with the testing branch. 

Here is the link to the Testing forum for Jalopy... You must Own Jalopy to see and post in this forum: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/446020/discussions/3/

At the bottom of this announcement will be directions on how to access this testing branch.

With this update, the gates to Turkey will open. I’ve decided not to post any screenshots of this particular map region, we’ll share some more details in due course along with a new trailer and music once we reach public release. 

Additionally, this is the first iteration of travelling back home via driving. Previously you could only return home with a fast travel system, but now you will be able to select a route by clicking “Head back” on the map. You will still need to complete a route and stay in a hotel at each town, but you can now spend some time within the areas you enjoy driving and spend that time scavenging for loot and upgrading your car.

It's worth noting that there is now a Notice board that appears when launching the game. This is to communicate any changes that some players may not have seen us talk about in the announcements or discussion posts. Right now, there's an important note on how Pad inputs work. They are disabled by default because they seem to cause some control conflict issues when turned on with some PC Set ups. However, if you want to play with a Pad, just enter the options menu and toggle it to on!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/6025d8c93a3894cb57824032004f1888a4eb0ff1.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! Today we have some great news for you, we’re going to be releasing a testing branch for the Turkey update. We intend to release the Turkey update in May but of course, no matter how much testing we put into the build, it cannot replicate the thousands of hours that the community can produce! So, we’re bound to miss a few things!

If you want to help us find those last few bugs then we’d greatly appreciate it. I’m going to tidy up the Steam Forums and introduce a new sub forum called the Turkey Bug Forum where players can report and post any issues that they have found with the testing branch. 

Here is the link to the Testing forum for Jalopy... You must Own Jalopy to see and post in this forum: 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/446020/discussions/3/

At the bottom of this announcement will be directions on how to access this testing branch.

With this update, the gates to Turkey will open. I’ve decided not to post any screenshots of this particular map region, we’ll share some more details in due course along with a new trailer and music once we reach public release. 

Additionally, this is the first iteration of travelling back home via driving. Previously you could only return home with a fast travel system, but now you will be able to select a route by clicking “Head back” on the map. You will still need to complete a route and stay in a hotel at each town, but you can now spend some time within the areas you enjoy driving and spend that time scavenging for loot and upgrading your car.

It's worth noting that there is now a Notice board that appears when launching the game. This is to communicate any changes that some players may not have seen us talk about in the announcements or discussion posts. Right now, there's an important note on how Pad inputs work. They are disabled by default because they seem to cause some control conflict issues when turned on with some PC Set ups. However, if you want to play with a Pad, just enter the options menu and toggle it to on!

notes.title: Bulgaria Update Out Now! Tyres, New Cashier System, New Music and 33% off
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/4a3d7dfc04bdb5cbceb72f10b66adbdb624a55b7.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

Jalopy has just received a brand new update which brings with it some adjustments to tyre wear, new tyre types, more music tracks Bulgaria to explore and a selection of other changes and fixes. For just a brief look at some of the changes, you can watch the trailer for the Bulgaria route here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PNqvW88vtwE
Those of you who want to know more about the changes, I’ll go into a lttle more detail below:

[h1]New Tyre System[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/12f9d596ee0afc95d2d2c0fa7cefa25c64f384e2.png[/img]

Previously, players would need to just replace their tyres when they burst. Now, we have a selection of different conditions which affect tyre traction. If you’re driving in pouring rain, you’re going to want wet tyres, if you fancy off roading, you’re probably going to want to fit some off road tyres.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/9230625f76d801042a4a1de83af5db4ba31c1bce.png[/img]

The tyres can be purchased from petrol stations and the Autershop at the end of each route and come in several variants including soft, medium and hard compound.

Soft Compound: Tyres wear at a faster rate but have an increased level of grip
Medium Compound: Tyres wear at an average rate and have an average level of grip
Hard compound: Tyres wear at a slower rate but they have a decreased level grip

Remember, your Laika 601 Deluxe can store two tyres in the trunk, but you can hold additional tyres with the officially licensed roof rack which can be found inside Laika Dealerships.

[h1]New Music[/h1]
Jeremy has been at it again and has created two more tracks for Jalopy! 

[h1]New Cashier system[/h1]
When selling goods, you now may be alerted by the cashier that they can’t afford to buy what you are selling. When choosing a route, the cashiers on the route will spawn with a certain number of finances available to them, up to 300. We have seen some playthroughs where a lucky spawn for a crate of wine will give players a massive influx of cash which makes upgrading your car much more satisfying.

Bear in mind though, that while the cashier may not be able to afford the goods you want to sell with cash, you may be able to exchange it for any items in the shop. Make sure to place the goods you want to trade it for onto the counter first before placing the goods you want to sell.

[h1]Bulgaria[/h1]

This is the penultimate location for Jalopy. It features large off road areas, winding roads and flooded off road tracks. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/faa1c3f7709e0f99ab125cd26c56eba86a98fca5.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/49013dca558d1459c14add32d1ecb030eebc4899.png[/img]

Greg is now at work on the Turkey route, which will be the final destination in Jalopy. Once that’s been added we will start looking at several other features including driving back home. More details will be shared in the coming weeks

To celebrate the new Bulgaria update, we have also put the game into a 33% off discount on Steam.

As always, thank you for the support, if you experience any issues, let us know in the forums or email us at support@excalibur-publishing.com
A full change Log is below

[h1]0.73[/h1]
- Top speed and acceleration now capped correctly when pushing the car while engine is running

[h1]0.72[/h1]
- Fixed wet tyre grip not being used in wet weather

[h1]0.71[/h1]
- Fixed scale issues 
– Fixed Letenye falling through environment issue 
- Further increased tyre grips to better reflect legacy tyres 
- fixed cursor menu issue 
- skip tutorial added into main menu

[h1]0.653[/h1]
- Halved the dry time for tyres after driving through puddles 
- Increased all tyre grip values by 50%
- Can no longer repair tyres with repair kits 
- damage to tyres caused by potholes now calculated at 25% of the previous implementation 
- Fixed various initialisation reference issues which may have been causing crashes 
- game now saves when using bed to sleep 
- increased likelyhood for 1, 2 and 3 tyres to spawn on abandoned cars 
- Always atleast 2 onroad tyres in shops and markets now Build 0.7 
- Added new naming conventions to tool rack spanners 
- Added two new music tracks by Jeremy 
- Fixed continue game crash -Important fix means the large number of players experiencing the game crashing on loading the game after selecting continue from the main menu - Lowered how much RAM Jalopy requires 
- Fixed various memory leaks - Optimised mesh data to be less demanding on Memory –
 Added garbage collection on scene load - Moved radio music to stream from disc, rather than the compressed version hogging a lot of RAM
 - Compressed music 
- Dramatically shortened a 16 min long static looping audio... –
 Fixed issue with windscreen damage not correcting when changing engine components 
- Lowered the volume of the radio static

[h1]0.61[/h1]
- Added Bulgaria
- Added Road Conditions 
- Added Pot Holes 
- Added oil spills 
- Changed notepad font
- Fixed spray paint not working on roof 
- Fixed being unable to interact with sun guard & ceiling light

-Cashiers now talk when they don't want to buy something from you
-Completed all newspaper events (CSFR - Turkey) 
- Fixed exploit where sold items falling out of the shop 
- Fixed up the notepad UI 
- Changed puddles to projectors rather than mesh 
- Increased Heavy Rain Puddle size 
- Optimised puddle loading 
- Can now pick up items dropped into puddles
- Economy state now only generates at the start of your journey (Germany) and is saved & loaded throughout your journey. This is to prevent exploiting shops where now...
- Shops are open in the mornings
- Now save the layout of Hubs, so you're layout will spawn the same when loading 
- Motel room you sleep in now saved and correctly loaded 
- Fixed Yugoslavia crates spawning over fences 
- Fixed Yugoslavia collision issue allowing players to get out of environment 
- Fixed floating fences in Yugoslavia 
- Added dynamic road conditioning for Bulgaria
- Reworked Tyres (details below) 
- Added Wet Weather tyres 
- Added Off-Road tyres 
- Added soft, medium and hard tyre compounds (additional options for grip & wear rates) 
- Lowered front and rear base grip levels for better car control 
- Weather now effects wear rates differently depending on the compound you are using (e.g. wet weather tyres burn up quicker in the dry) 
- Grip now correctly updates based on the tyre compound and terrain the tyre is driving over 
- New visual effects for flat tyres of all compound types
- Can now purchase wet, off-road tyres in variety of different compounds from both the Outershop and Petrol Stations 
- Petrol Stations & Outershops now have added signage 
- Changed the way checks for cursor locking works which should hopefully fix the issues some players are having with their cursor not locking to centre 
- Flat tyre now has a rolling audio to make it more apparent when you're driving with a flat

notes.title: Bulgaria Update Out Now! Tyres, New Cashier System, New Music and 33% off
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/4a3d7dfc04bdb5cbceb72f10b66adbdb624a55b7.png[/img]
Hello everyone,

Jalopy has just received a brand new update which brings with it some adjustments to tyre wear, new tyre types, more music tracks Bulgaria to explore and a selection of other changes and fixes. For just a brief look at some of the changes, you can watch the trailer for the Bulgaria route here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PNqvW88vtwE
Those of you who want to know more about the changes, I’ll go into a lttle more detail below:

[h1]New Tyre System[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/12f9d596ee0afc95d2d2c0fa7cefa25c64f384e2.png[/img]

Previously, players would need to just replace their tyres when they burst. Now, we have a selection of different conditions which affect tyre traction. If you’re driving in pouring rain, you’re going to want wet tyres, if you fancy off roading, you’re probably going to want to fit some off road tyres.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/9230625f76d801042a4a1de83af5db4ba31c1bce.png[/img]

The tyres can be purchased from petrol stations and the Autershop at the end of each route and come in several variants including soft, medium and hard compound.

Soft Compound: Tyres wear at a faster rate but have an increased level of grip
Medium Compound: Tyres wear at an average rate and have an average level of grip
Hard compound: Tyres wear at a slower rate but they have a decreased level grip

Remember, your Laika 601 Deluxe can store two tyres in the trunk, but you can hold additional tyres with the officially licensed roof rack which can be found inside Laika Dealerships.

[h1]New Music[/h1]
Jeremy has been at it again and has created two more tracks for Jalopy! 

[h1]New Cashier system[/h1]
When selling goods, you now may be alerted by the cashier that they can’t afford to buy what you are selling. When choosing a route, the cashiers on the route will spawn with a certain number of finances available to them, up to 300. We have seen some playthroughs where a lucky spawn for a crate of wine will give players a massive influx of cash which makes upgrading your car much more satisfying.

Bear in mind though, that while the cashier may not be able to afford the goods you want to sell with cash, you may be able to exchange it for any items in the shop. Make sure to place the goods you want to trade it for onto the counter first before placing the goods you want to sell.

[h1]Bulgaria[/h1]

This is the penultimate location for Jalopy. It features large off road areas, winding roads and flooded off road tracks. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/faa1c3f7709e0f99ab125cd26c56eba86a98fca5.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/49013dca558d1459c14add32d1ecb030eebc4899.png[/img]

Greg is now at work on the Turkey route, which will be the final destination in Jalopy. Once that’s been added we will start looking at several other features including driving back home. More details will be shared in the coming weeks

To celebrate the new Bulgaria update, we have also put the game into a 33% off discount on Steam.

As always, thank you for the support, if you experience any issues, let us know in the forums or email us at support@excalibur-publishing.com

Hello everyone,

Today, we’re releasing a new build onto the Patch test area of Jalopy. In order to access it you’ll need to select the patch area from within Steam. Details on how to do this will be at the bottom of this post. It is important to note that this patch build is being released to help us track down any issues that we may have missed from internal testing.

Once this build hits as a full release I’ll share more details with screenshots and a full breakdown and explanation of any core changes. The major changes are below:

[h1]Tyres[/h1]
We've  introduced new types of tires including wet and off road tyres. These each have a soft, medium or hard compound. So if your cars grip is less than expected, chances are you’re going to need to replace the tyres.

- Overall car weight now affects all tyre grip, the heavier the car the more traction it will have (car weight can be viewed in the user manual) 
- Fixed 0 pricing issue caused by economy generation

[h1]0.644[/h1]
 - Can no longer drop tyre iron while removing tyres, which was causing tyre iron to get locked in hands unusable
- Fixed issue with tyre iron bolt not unhighlighting when hovering over the tyres - will make it much clearer when removing tyres
- Fixed red tube carburetor having constant spanner UI appear
- Fixed being able to drop the car jack while loosening wheel bolts
- Fixed potholes and puddles appearing sideways over railroads in CSFR
- Fixed AI pileup issue in Hungary
- Fixed electrical audio hum not playing near Petrol Station signage

[h1]0.645[/h1]
- Fixed weird issues caused by economy State & hub Layout not deleting during new game
- Stealing & saving now removes all home storage and all items stored in them. CRIME DOES NOT PAY.
- Lowered joypad dead zone from 0.5 to 0.1
- Further increased tyre grip levels and additional 20%

[h1]0.6451[/h1]
- Reverted input sensitivity changes

[h1]0.6452[/h1]
-implemented saving and loading of tyres
-tyres will not return to axle when taking other tyres out of the boot below!

[h1]Accessing the Public Beta[/h1]
We have performed some tests here and have found save data from previous builds should work in the public beta. However, we recommend that you back up save data from the games folder as there could be a chance that save data may be lost. Additionally, there may be some issues that you will encounter. Do let us know if you come across anything! Details on how to install the public beta are below: 
1.	Right click on Jalopy in your Steam library and select properties
2.	A window will open up, click beta
3.	Select Public Beta from the drop down menu
4.	The game should now update, but Steam may need to restart if it does not download

notes.title: Public Beta - Bulgaria, Tyres and More
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today, we’re releasing a new build onto the Patch test area of Jalopy. In order to access it you’ll need to select the patch area from within Steam. Details on how to do this will be at the bottom of this post. It is important to note that this patch build is being released to help us track down any issues that we may have missed from internal testing.

Once this build hits as a full release I’ll share more details with screenshots and a full breakdown and explanation of any core changes. The major changes are below:

[h1]Tyres[/h1]
We've  introduced new types of tires including wet and off road tyres. These each have a soft, medium or hard compound. So if your cars grip is less than expected, chances are you’re going to need to replace the tyres.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/a98e19683f75e61b6deecb4e1c15eeb9bb0ce3b8.png[/img]

[h1]Bulgaria[/h1]
Twisty roads, hills and some other features await for you in this new route. It will be much tougher than before to reach Bulgaria due to the changes mentioned previously. But I hope you’ll enjoy the route when you get there!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/17770261/faa1c3f7709e0f99ab125cd26c56eba86a98fca5.png[/img]

notes.title: Jalopy Build 06203 Now Live (Rolling And Pushing)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

The latest build of Jalopy (Build 06203) is now live. This build contains some slight improvements to the AI performance but also a couple of new features. 

The images below are from the [url=https://twitter.com/JalopyGame]@JalopyGame[/url] twitter account. Make sure to follow as Greg posts a few teaser images and details on this account.

If you've somehow managed to topple your car over into a full roll, you'll now be able to salvage the car by rolling it back into the upright position. Simply click on the cars frame and you'll attempt to roll it back over.

[img]http://imgur.com/gHoQoD3.gif[/img]

Those who became stranded due to running out of fuel or neglecting general maintenance used to have to walk to the nearest petrol station. While you'll still need to try and get to the petrol station, at least you can now bring the car with you. Hop out of the car, click and hold on the steering wheel and push!

[img]http://imgur.com/6AxdOnT.gif[/img]

We noticed in the last build that some users are experiencing FPS drops. If this build has not increased the FPS for you, please do the following:

[list][*]Go into the options menu and decrease the AI density
[*]If this doesn't work, contact us at support@excalibur-publishing.com with your dxdiag and details on estimated frame rates and where you experience any drops[/list]

We'll do our very best to help anyone who contacts us on this, so any further info would allow us to work towards any fixes.

[h1]Changelog 06203[/h1]
[*]Doubled timestep to improve physics performance (physics now ticks at 100fps rather than 200fps) 
[*]Can now roll the car by clicking on the frame 
[*]Can now push the car by clicking and holding on the steering wheel while outside of the drivers seat 
[*]Cleaned up the car jack so it doesn't appear floating anymore[/list

tags.feature: Can now roll the car by clicking on the frame
Can now push the car by clicking and holding on the steering wheel while outside of the drivers seat

notes.title: Build 0614 E -
notes.content:
Hello everyone.

We're working very hard on trying to fix the issues that some players have been having with Jalopy. Today, we're releasing another patch which we hopes eliminates some of the crashing players have had when trying to start a new game. 

We've discovered that the "Skip Tutorial" option when starting a new game can cause some crashes. So we have had to make the tough decision to remove the skip tutorial option.

notes.title: Yugoslavia Update Now Live. Screenshots, Video And 33% Off!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today we are releasing a new update to Jalopy which adds a new region to drive your Laika 601 deluxe and also adds some new features and bug fixes. First I’d like to thank everyone who has been a part of the public beta branch and has reported any bugs or issues, this type of feedback has really helped us make sure that the build is good to go once it releases to everyone.
So what’s in the new update? I’ll detail some of the core changes below but a compiled changelog will be at the very bottom of this announcement.

Those who want to watch the update in action check out the video below, scroll further down and we’ll detail what each of the mechanics do in more detail

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nOMoACw8NfQ

[h1]Yugoslavia[/h1]
The next stop in our pilgrimage! The coastal region of Yugoslavia features some stunning horizon vistas and winding roads.

[img]http://imgur.com/L91ks7V.jpg[/img]
[img]http://imgur.com/j4Iloxy.jpg[/img]
[img]http://imgur.com/Ez45LS7.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Digital Dash Display[/h1]
The digital dash display is  just one of three new major upgrades that can be bought from the Laika dealership. This piece of tech will provide a visual display on your dashboard to alert you of any issues with the engine, oil levels and tyre durability. 

[img]http://imgur.com/FzkaUf2.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Tool Rack[/h1]
The tool rack contains three items, the car jack, a spanner and a crowbar. Installing this upgrade means that there will be a dedicated space for all three of these items without compromising any of the available space in your trunk. The spanner included in the tool rack can be used to repair engine components. The level of damage that the spanner can repair is based around the level of the tool kit itself.

[img]http://imgur.com/9Ru6rtM.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Light Rack[/h1]
The final upgrade is the Light rack. Installing this will allow for better visibility at night by providing a more powerful beam of light. 

[img]http://imgur.com/dZgV9ah.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Music[/h1]
Jeremy, who has composed all tracks in the game has added a further two new tracks titled; “Harmonikatalas” and “Krugovi”. Accompanying these new tracks is a visual update to the radio itself.

[img]http://imgur.com/QFnhWKt.jpg[/img]

[h1]Xbox 360 Controller support[/h1]
One of the major requests from players has been to add support for controllers. The xbox 360 controller can now be used for all areas of the game. Those awaiting for wheel support however, this is the first step towards achieving that goal. We’re still looking into it and will have more news to share later.

[img]http://imgur.com/TpTib6E.jpg[/img]

[h1]Car Horn[/h1]
Express yourself with the car horn, someone cut you up? BEEEEEEEP! In a stale mate for the last parking spot? BEEEEEEEP! 

[img]http://imgur.com/6SjIjxq.jpg[/img]

[h1]Baskets[/h1]
On your journey, you’ll secure several boxes. Unfortunately unpacking those from the car and handing each item one by one to the cashier can be quite a tedious process. But with the new-fangled basket technology you can place a larger amount of items in the basket and then bulk sell everything by handing the basket straight to the cashier!

[img]http://imgur.com/nKHeVnT.jpg[/img]

[h1]Home Storage[/h1]
While there are still plenty of other changes (See the changelog below) the last major addition is the Home storage. This an area inside your home garage which will allow you to store car components and paints. You’ll need to buy some boxes first, and then when you travel home (via the pause menu or the map), place the items straight into the boxes and it will save the items placed inside the crates when you save and quit the game.

[img]http://imgur.com/WuWUbvr.jpg[/img]

So there we are, The Yugoslavia update is now live!  We hope that you enjoy exploring the new area and the new features of the game. Once again, thank you to everyone who participated in the public beta and posted any issues.

We uploaded multiple builds over the past few weeks on the public beta branch and below is a document of all the changes and additions during this time. 

[h1]Build 0.613 - C [/h1]
[list][*]Allowed Vsync option to be used again (please note this has caused serious issues for some card users, use with caution)
[*]Fixed reverse pad issue[/list]

[h1]Build 0613[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed Jack popping out of inventory
 [*]Fixed issue with double clicking hotel bed causing the game to soft lock
[*]Change tool rack flavour text to read more concise
[*]Can no longer sell the tool rack items
[*]Prevented being able to pick up the same item twice 
[*]Fixed "glow in the dark" maps
[*]Fixed 360 pad not working in the tutorial
[*]Remapped brake to Left Bumper Button to prevent car braking while using stuff on the dash
[*]Items in hand now sway when using pad input
[*]Lowered polycount of towns, optimising rendering somewhat (more to do on this throughout development). 
[*]Fixed skiddding audio in light rain
[*]Shop keepers now remember when it's your first time entering a shop
[*]Fixed crates loading half their size
[*]Fixed issue with not being able to refill water tank with saved water
[*]Can now refill water tanks outside of the engine
[*]Bottled Water price now based on amount of water in the bottle 
[*]Fuel cans value now based on amount of fuel they come filled with
[*]Can now mix oil into Fuel Cans (oil increases oil mix, fuel decreases) 
[*]Advanced saving implemented
The amount of water in bottles is now saved and loaded correctly - Fuel cans now save the amount of fuel in them - Oil Bottles now save the amount of oil they contain - Fuel can oil mix now saves - Engine Component stored in inventory now save condition value - Batterys in inventory now save their charge amount - Water tanks in inventory now save their water level
[*]Fixed issue with colliders not activating correctly when dropping items (most notable with trying to pick up baskets) 
[*]Fixed issue with fuel lids not closing after refueling the portable fuel canister 
[*]Fixed issue with tool rack car jack placement helper not stopping rendering when returning to the tool rack 
[*]Fixed issue with not being able to pay fine at the border crossings 
[*]Added condition which prevents players from passage if they cannot afford the border fine (also means that the bug with being stuck at the border if you don't have enough money is now fixed)
[*]Fixed issue with wallet making the boot / trunk inventory slot 1 become unoccupied[/list]

[h1]Build 0.612[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue with level 2 and 3 tool racks not loading 
[*]Added a new loading screen 
[*]Moved game loading to a separate and lower priority thread, but unity still has bottle neck issues with loading which I'm not able to access, so some momentary hitches during loading screen still occur. 
[*]Rebuilt how windscreen visual damage works, so should be a more reliable indicator of car overall damage 
[*]Fixed car tipping over (for reals this time, I think) 
[*]Added collisions to gate cars at scrapyards 
[*]Cleaned up the visuals of scrapyards slightly to make it easier to spot scrapped components 
[*]Added bulk selling when using the shopping baskets at the checkout counter 
[*]Fixed shopping basket weight being applied to car weight when out of the car 
[*]Added touched up loading art from Gunstone Build 0.612 
[*]Fixed CSFR Map Yugoslavia error - Fixed floating puddle in CSFR 
[*]Removed doppler effect which distorted audio playback 
[*]Added pause option to allow hiding cursor 
[*]Fixed issue with R joystick look not working for brand new players 
[*]Uncle no longer flips car during tutorial 
[*]Fixed some shopping basket clipping issues 
[*]Fixed shops breaking if trying to sell an item with a value of 0 
[*]Added bulk selling when using the shopping baskets at the checkout counter (you can now use a bucket filled with goods and the cashier will sort them all for you) 
[*]Fixed issue with level 2 and 3 tool racks not loading[/list]

[h1]Build 0.606[/h1]
[list] [*]Fixed car jack save issue 
[*]Esc can now close map book again 
[*]Added 2 new tracks by Jeremy; Harmonikatalas & Krugovi 
[*]Fixed repeating popping tyre audio 
[*]Fixed issue with storage price costing twice as much as it should 
[*]Picking up the gas/petrol can no longer forces it to hand 1 
[*]storage space no longer saves after storage, this is to prevent a money exploit 
[*]Fixed audio option in main menu reading video [/list]

[h1]Build 0.607/8[/h1]
[list][*]Fixed issue with gate not opening at shopes 
[*]Fixed issue with unpaid car jacks becoming stuck under the car 
[*]Cleaned up interactions with car jacks staying after driving away 
[*]Fixed crash on load issue[/list]

[h1]Build 0.600[/h1]
[*]Added Yugoslavia 
[*]Magazines now zoom out correctly if picked up while zoomed in 
[*]Refactored how fuel, electric, oil and water are now ready by the car 
[*]Replaced Laika bonnet sigil 
[*]Added car horn 
[*]Added digital dash upgrade 
[*]Added home storage 
[*]Handbrake now sets engine torque / current speed to 0 
[*]Reverse audio now fixed 
[*]Fixed exploit of being able to climb over petrol station counter 
[*]Added correct animated flags to border crossings 
[*]Correct banned goods on border sign when Loading into a town 
[*]Fixed car topping over issue 
[*]Fuel cans will now span in shops empty 
[*]Fixed issue with oil adding 2 charges if tanks was in engine 
[*]Fixed issue with Laika Catalogue UI chaing colour after using paint menu 
[*]Added working mirrors (turn them off/on in settings menu) 
[*]Components now lose value based on their condition 
[*]Fixed component price not showing on the UI Notepad 
[*]Fixed Save corruption issue caused by newspapers + paper cups 
[*]Can no longer put the wallet or passport in the trunk (boot) This would cause save corruption errors 
[*]Rebuilt collision interaction to allow multiple collisions on single object 
[*]Beside alarm clock can now be set to silent (press button in to turn off alarm for next time you wake) [/list]

[h1]Build 0.601[/h1]
[list][*]Added Digital Dash Display upgrade 
[*]Added Tool Rack Upgrade
- Level 1 (first purchase) allows repairing components up to 33% of their max durability 
- Level 2 (second purchase) allows repairing components up to 66% of their max durability 
- Level 3 (third purchase) allows repairing components up to 100% of their max durability 
[*]Also contains a crowbar and a carjack 
[*]Added Light Rack upgrade 
[*]Added Baskets which allow players to place items into and carry (items in the basket will also be saved correctly) 
[*]Fixed issue with front license plate vanishing 
[*]Added 360 pad input support for walking and driving (first iteration) 
[*]Added Antialiasing 
[*]Changed main menu cursor to finger, so it is more apparent 
[*]Cleaned up finger UI 
[*]Lightened the blacks in the game as they were really hard to read on most monitors 
[*]New radio model 
[*]New Bonnet lever model, bonnet moved out further to be more apparent 
[*]Lightened Ambient lighting levels for all conditions to make game brighter 
[*]Removed page zooming from user manual 
[*]Returned street lighting to Towns 
[*]Pathfinding now initiates a rescan on dropping the car down with the car jack, this should prevent the uncle getting stuck during the tutorial 
[*]Added Menu support for 360 controller 
[*]Fixed issue with being able to take keys out of ignition while engine is on 
[*]Fixed home storage issues [/list]

[h1]Build 0.602[/h1]
[list] [*]Fixed screen res issues defaulting to 0x0 
[*]Main Menu book can now be closed with pad input B or Esc key 
[*]Fixed issue with Main Menu book being closed before fully opened yet text still appearing 
[*]Added functionality for using sliders with pad input 
[*]Reset the position of Back and Accept on Main Menu Options screen [/list]

[h1]Build 0.603[/h1]
[list][*]Cancel transaction lever now takes into account items in inventories and hands 
[*]Fixed an issue with pump not returning to fuel pump 
[*]Fixed crate locks not rotating with wooden boxes [/list]

[h1]Build 0.604/5[/h1]
[list][*]Further fixes relating to the above[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.612 now available in Yugoslavia Public Beta
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Today there’s a new build in the beta branch for Jalopy. Details on how to access this branch will be at the bottom of this announcement.

[h1]Build 0.612[/h1]
•	Fixed issue with level 2 and 3 tool racks not loading 
•	Added a new loading screen 
•	Moved game loading to a separate and lower priority thread, but unity still has bottle neck issues with loading which I'm not able to access, so some momentary hitches during loading screen still occur. 
•	Rebuilt how windscreen visual damage works, so should be a more reliable indicator of car overall damage 
•	Fixed car tipping over (for reals this time, I think) 
•	Added collisions to gate cars at scrapyards 
•	Cleaned up the visuals of scrapyards slightly to make it easier to spot scrapped components 
•	Fixed some shopping basket clipping issues 
•	Fixed shops breaking if trying to sell an item with a value of 0 
•	Added bulk selling when using the shopping baskets at the checkout counter 
•	Fixed shopping basket weight being applied to car weight when out of the car 
•	Added touched up loading art from Gunstone Build 0.612 
•	Fixed CSFR Map Yugoslavia error - Fixed floating puddle in CSFR 
•	Removed doppler effect which distorted audio playback 
•	Added pause option to allow hiding cursor 
•	Fixed issue with R joystick look not working for brand new players 
•	Uncle no longer flips car during tutorial
•	Fixed some shopping basket clipping issues 
•	Fixed shops breaking if trying to sell an item with a value of 0 
•	Added bulk selling when using the shopping baskets at the checkout counter (you can now use a bucket filled with goods and the cashier will sort them all for you) 
•	Fixed shopping basket weight being applied to car weight when out of the car
•	Fixed issue with level 2 and 3 tool racks not loading 

[h1]Known issues:[/h1]
•	We recommend playing through the tutorial with the mouse and keyboard. There is a small hiccup in the game when using a 360 controller that can halt progress through the tutorial
•	Some issues when trying to reverse on an xbox 360 controller when completely stationary. If the car is in any sort of movement though, the player can reverse. 

If you have any issues, do let us know in the forums.

To access the beta branch, right click on Jalopy in your game library, select properties. In the window select the Beta tab and click on the drop down box to select “Public beta”.

notes.title: Further Updates to Yugoslavia Beta
notes.content:
Hello Jalopy drivers.

We have had fantastic feedback to the public beta of the new Yugoslavia update. Many of you have commented and left some great feedback, and of course found some bugs. We have been hard at work and fixed quite a few of these already.

We have a new build being uploaded as I type this so a new update should be available to download shortly.

[h1][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h1]

[h1]Build 0.606[/h1]
- Fixed car jack save issue
- Esc can now close map book again
- Added 2 new tracks by Jeremy; Harmonikatalas & Krugovi
- Fixed repeating popping tyre audio
- Fixed isse with storage price costing twice as much as it should
- Picking up the gas/petrol can no longer forces it to hand 1
- storage space no longer saves after storage, this is to prevent a money exploit
- Fixed audio option in main menu reading video

[h1]Build 0.607/8 [/h1]
- Fixed issue with gate not opening at shopes
- Fixed issue with unpaid car jacks becoming stuck under the car
- Cleaned up interactions with car jacks staying after driving away
- Fixed crash on load issue

[h1][u]How do I access the beta?[/u][/h1]

To access the public beta please follow the steps below. 
1.	Open Steam on your PC and go to your library 
2.	Right click on Jalopy and then click on Properties 
3.	Select the BETAS tab and then in the dropdown menu select public_beta 
4.	Once selected, Steam should automatically start downloading the beta content 

Thank you again for all your support
